# Customer Value First

Technology exists to create value. Not the other way around.

Engineers should understand who the customer is, what problem is being solved, and why the work matters.

---

## What Good Looks Like

- Engineers can explain business outcomes, not just technical outputs
- Roadmaps are linked to business objectives
- Success is measured through outcomes

**Good outcome framing:**
- Reduced onboarding time by 40%
- Increased customer adoption by 15%
- Reduced support tickets by 25%

**Poor output framing:**
- Delivered 30 tickets
- Completed 12 epics
- Wrote 10,000 lines of code

---

## Anti-Patterns

- Building technology without understanding users
- Prioritising technical novelty over business value
- Measuring success solely by output
